verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly market debugging via natural language (e.g., 'Debug live web applications', 'Build, debug, and ship', codebase mapping/explaining, plain-language task description), and one community comment praises its code-assistant ability. However, multiple hands-on reports describe unreliable self-verification, buggy replace_all fixes, and degraded output quality, indicating debugging support works but with significant caveats.
